title: Promotional Page Design Services Contract (synthetic exercise)
origin: Written by the project authors; all parties and business facts are fictional.
scope: For practice in reading and drafting contracts only; not a contract ready to be signed.

clauses.C1: The Client engages the Designer to produce a promotional page. The Designer shall provide several design drafts and the necessary source files, and the deliverables are complete when the Client is satisfied.
clauses.C2: The total project price is RMB 10,000. The Client pays thirty percent up front, and the balance is paid promptly after the project ends. Any additional costs arising from the project will be handled separately.
clauses.C3: The Designer shall complete delivery as soon as possible. The Client may add content at any time, added work does not change the original schedule, and the Designer shall cooperate to complete it.
clauses.C4: The Client reviews the design drafts for acceptance after receiving them, and no reply does not mean acceptance. The Client may ask the Designer for revisions, with no limit on the number of revisions.
clauses.C5: Ownership of all design work belongs to the Client, and the Designer's existing templates, fonts and third-party materials are also transferred to the Client.
clauses.C6: The Client may end the engagement at any time without paying for unfinished work. If the Designer ends it early, the Designer must refund all payments; how completed work is confirmed and handed over will be negotiated separately by the parties.
clauses.C7: The Designer may use the customer list provided by the Client to produce sample drafts. Either party may show all project materials in its own promotion, and use of the materials is no longer restricted after the contract ends.
